name: r16_slot_that_overflows
why: A slot 120 long on a plate that shortens from 200 to 150. The slot sticks out, and it must fail NOISILY: a slot open on the side is a different part, and if it comes out without saying anything it is the worst defect of the section.
intent_why: the slot is where the designer put it, at the centre. Shortening the plate does not move it -- it makes it leave the material, and that is what we want to see said.

after.tolerance_why: 150*120*20 = 360000 minus the WHOLE slot: (120-20)*20 + pi*10^2 = 2314.159 over 20 of thickness. If the slot sticks out, less comes out, and that is what this case looks for. The calculation has pi inside
